zh: 现在，我们是新技术的诞生之地。

speaker: Unknown
en: And our mission is to help normal countries to become stronger and to stop the war and to prevent the start of the Third World War.
zh: 我们的使命是帮助正常国家变得更强大，制止战争，并防止第三次世界大战的爆发。

speaker: Unknown
en: And are you actively working with NATO or with the US?
zh: 那你们是否在积极地与 NATO 或美国合作？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And is that in technology transfer?
zh: 那是技术转让吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Are you licensing it to other militaries or you're just advising them how to build a system?
zh: 你们是把它授权给其他军队，还是只是建议他们如何构建系统？

speaker: Unknown
en: There are different models of cooperation.
zh: 有不同的合作模式。

speaker: Unknown
en: How much have you spent on hardware?
zh: 你们在硬件上花了多少钱？

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you have a sense?
zh: 你们有概念吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: nationally since 2022 as opposed to what a major power military would have spent during that time frame.
zh: 自 2022 年以来全国范围的花费，对比一个主要军事强国在同一时间段会花费的金额。

speaker: Unknown
en: The U.S. has spent billions of dollars attacking Iran and it seems that you've been able to hold off
zh: 美国已经花了数十亿美元攻击伊朗，而你们似乎能够以低得多的成本

speaker: Unknown
en: Russia for years at a much lower cost.
zh: 抵挡俄罗斯多年。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you have a sense of that cost differential?
zh: 你们对这种成本差异有概念吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course.
zh: 当然。

speaker: Unknown
en: And economics of the war, this is a very important aspect, war strategy.
zh: 战争经济学，这是战争中非常重要的一个方面，战争战略。 [[257补充略]]

speaker: Unknown
en: If you need to waste $1 million to hit one Shahid that costs $50,000, this is in favor of the enemy.
zh: 如果你需要浪费 100 万美元去击落一架成本 5 万美元的 Shahid,这是有利于敌人的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, and this is one of the reasons why interceptors appear.
zh: 当然，这也是拦截机出现的原因之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because investors that cost a few thousands effectively destroy shahids that cost 50,000.
zh: 因为成本只有几千美元的拦截机能够有效地摧毁成本 5 万美元的 Shahid。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is economics of the war in favor of Ukraine, of defending government.
zh: 这就是有利于乌克兰、有利于防御方的战争经济学。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's why when we identified in 2024, we saw the potential.
zh: 这就是为什么当我们在 2024 年识别出这一点时，我们看到了潜力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it became one of the most important areas of work of BRAE1 and Ministry of Digital Transformation to implement and to scale this technology.
zh: 于是这成为 BRAE1 和数字化转型部最重要的工作领域之一，去实施并规模化这项技术。

speaker: Unknown
en: And right now we have more than 150 different Ukrainian companies who produce interceptors.
zh: 现在我们有超过 150 家不同的乌克兰公司生产拦截机。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the market is not mature.
zh: 而且这个市场还不成熟。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the new models, new approaches of intercepting appearing on the market and inventing by Ukrainian and right now international companies.
zh: 拦截的新模式、新方法正在市场上出现，由乌克兰公司、以及现在的国际公司所发明。

speaker: Unknown
en: Three international companies who produce interceptors very actively work here in Ukraine.
zh: 三家生产拦截机的国际公司非常积极地在乌克兰开展工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they do amazing things.
zh: 而且它们在做了不起的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: As a result, the capitalization level of this company and market valuation became very high because every company who would like to be the player in the defense industry has to be here in Ukraine and their products have to be tested.
zh: 结果是，这些公司和市场的资本化水平变得非常高，因为每一个想成为国防工业参与者的公司都必须来到乌克兰，它们的产品必须经过测试。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sometimes we're shocked when the different countries buy the drones that have not been tested in Ukraine but just declared that they work.
zh: 有时我们会感到震惊，当不同国家购买那些没有在乌克兰测试过、只是宣称有效的无人机。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the answer is, come to us.
zh: 而我们的回答是，来我们这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are happy to help and test and give the recommendation, some validation report and recommendation report.
zh: 我们很乐意帮助并进行测试，给出验证报告和建议报告。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can, after that, take a decision.
zh: 在那之后，你就可以做出决定。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is it really a good drone that will effectively work against Shahid?
zh: 它究竟是一架能有效对抗 Shahid 的好无人机？

speaker: Unknown
en: Or is it just an illusion of having the defense or security?
zh: 还是仅仅是一种拥有防御或安全的错觉？
